```yaml
name: Deploy Docker Image

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Deployment environment'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/questarr:${{ github.sha::7 }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ github.ref_name }}

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment }}
    if: inputs.environment == 'production'
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to production server
        env:
          HOST: 0.0.0.0
        run: |
          echo "Deploying to production..."
          ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no ${{ secrets.PROD_SSH_USER }}@${{ secrets.PROD_SSH_HOST }} << 'EOF'
          docker pull ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/questarr:${{ github.sha::7 }}
          docker stop questarr || true
          docker rm questarr || true
          docker run -d --name questarr -p 80:80 -e HOST=$HOST ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/questarr:${{ github.sha::7 }}
          EOF
```
